title: In an emergency
lead: If anyone is hurt or in danger, call 911 first. Then use the contacts below.

steps.title: Someone is hurt or unsafe
steps.detail: Stay on the line. Do not wait on other numbers first.

steps.title: Smell gas or see a downed power line
steps.detail: Leave the area if it feels unsafe. PG&E emergency: 1-800-743-5000.

steps.title: House power is out
steps.detail: Powerwall may keep lights on. SMUD: 1-888-742-7683.

steps.title: Internet is down
steps.detail: Primary is Fidium (1-866-356-5864). Starlink is the backup path — give it a few minutes to take over.
